title: accounts.probe result

provider.description: A provider's id, as the environment's adapter registry keys it: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (claude).

directory.description: The machine's own provider directory; null when the provider has none on this environment.

signedIn.description: Whether its status read says it is signed in.

provider.description: A provider's id, as the environment's adapter registry keys it: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (claude).

email.description: The login's email, as the provider's status reports it.

organisation.description: The organisation the login belongs to, when the provider reports one.

anyOf.description: Who an account signed in as: the provider, the email and the organisation when present; one account per identity per environment.

identity.description: Who it is signed in as; null when signed out or not read.

anyOf.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

accountId.description: The account that already holds the directory, adopted; null when none does.

detail.description: Why the status could not be read, when it could not.

description: The machine's own provider directory as accounts.probe read it: present or not, signed in as whom, and the account adopting it holds, if any.
